# Xeno
Xenos are a species of former xenomorphs captured and raised by TSM (Trans-Solar Marines). Fearing rebellion, marines made them highly dependent on human food to survive. While retaining some xenomorph traits, they face hostility from their hive mother, who still views them as enemies.
## The Hunger
[color=#999999][italic]"Yummy!"[/italic][/color]
While Xenos are able to store significant reserves of nutrients in their bodies, they also burn through them at alarming rates. A starving Xeno becomes downright ravenous, and may devour enough food to feed four people in one sitting.
## Racial Features - Take [color=#00aa00]10% less[/color] caustic damage. - Common acids [color=#00aa00]do not hurt[/color]. - [color=#FFA500]Your blood is acid[/color]. - Take [color=#aa0000]30% more[/color] shock damage.
- You get hungry [color=#aa0000]very quickly[/color]. - You [color=#00aa00]do not get slowed[/color] when starving. - You can [color=#FFA500]store extra nutrients[/color], so eating a lot will keep you sated for longer. - You can [color=#00aa00]eat almost anything[/color], including rotten food.
- Your tail is sharp and pointy. You may [color=#00aa00]use it as a spear[/color]. - You can [color=#FFA500]talk to wild xenos[/color], but they remain hostile.
